author: Climate Town
description:
[Infomercial voice] THERE’S GOT TO BE A BETTER WAY! A lot of internet culture warring focuses on gas stoves, but the real gas user is heating your house. Lucky for us, instead of lighting a fire in our basements, electric heat pump technology can now do the job way more efficiently. Check out a quick run down on heat pumps vs gas, and check out the folks at Conservation Law Foundation for a more in-depth look at a superior technology. https://www.clf.org/blog/do-heat-pumps-work-year-round/

And of course, check out our favorite video from This Old House: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-vU9x3dFMrU
title: Your Gas Stove Is A Trojan Horse
